prior_summary: Prismatic relational conditioning for a learned action DDPM: typed robot, drawer, red and blue nodes exchange messages using moving-drawer coordinates, with separate world-X axial and YZ transverse channels on drawer edges. Robot joints and world positions preserve reachability and gravity information. A masked drawer-displacement prediction auxiliary trains the shared causal encoder.
applicable_conditions: Same Panda with pd_joint_pos, fixed cabinet geometry and world -X drawer opening. Requires two causal state observations containing qpos/qvel, TCP/red/blue world poses (metres, wxyz), drawer position and velocity. Supported entry is the demonstrated closed-drawer start or partway along the observed approach, handle pull/release, retreat, red approach and pickup manifold. Arbitrary open-drawer starts or changed cabinet frames are not established.
termination_guidance: Train and invoke over the full expanded open_access slice, not only until drawer_position exceeds 0.26 m. Overlap with evacuate_red begins during the loaded pull near d=0.1863 m and includes release near d=0.300 m, upward retreat, red approach, closing and initial lift. Transfer early only to a successor that can continue those transition phases. The late boundary has red z about 0.142-0.143 m, TCP roughly 0.009 m on red's -X side, each finger about 0.0182 m and joint/red/TCP motion consistent with upward lift. Preserve the red grasp at late transfer; opening completion is not a command to open fingers. These are observational guidance, not hard gates or additional task-success criteria.
limitations: Only twelve successful, nearly identical drawer-opening demonstrations support the prior; modest red/blue placement differences are present. No demonstrated blocked-drawer recovery, arbitrary rotation/translation invariance, explicit contact sensor, IK, collision projection or grasp guarantee. Two causal observations may not resolve stationary dwell-time ambiguity. The auxiliary predicts demonstrated drawer evolution from state, not the effect of a particular sampled action. Full task completion also requires red on the outside pad and blue inside at the same observation; this policy ends at initial red lift, not full task completion.

config.orientation_features: nine rotation-matrix entries from normalized wxyz quaternions
config.causal_temporal_fusion: MLP of previous node features, current node features, and their difference
config.action_representation: eight original-shared-normalized absolute joint and gripper targets
config.normalization: Shared complete-original-demonstration range normalizer; relative scales are sums of the corresponding shared half ranges, with zero center range in fixed Y/Z. No per-skill fit or observation clipping.

auxiliary.name: causal_latent_to_future_drawer_displacement
auxiliary.target: (future drawer position - current drawer position) / shared drawer half range
auxiliary.mask: future_mask times action mask, excluding slot 0 whose post-state is current t
auxiliary.loss: mean squared displacement error over valid slots 1 through 15
auxiliary.gradient_path: drawer head and shared relational/temporal encoder; diffusion loss also trains encoder and U-Net

config.slice_contract: All assigned actions are retained. Start is inclusive and stop is exclusive; padding never crosses the skill boundary.
